card_title: Artist Notes: Continuous Hold Setting Spray
summary: Environmental lockdown. A micro-fine mist that binds makeup to the skin, rendering it impervious to heat, humidity, and friction.
description: The ultimate atmospheric shield. This advanced polymer spray creates an invisible, flexible film over your complexion architecture, preventing oxidation, melting, or transferring for up to 16 hours.
technical_overview: Offered at $28.0 for 100ml, this KoColor SETTING_SPRAY is expertly formulated with Water, PVP, Niacinamide, and Aloe Extract. It delivers a high-fidelity Clear Mist color profile (`#F0F8FF`) and leverages film-forming polymer technology.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Hold 10 inches from the face and mist in an "X" and "T" formation.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Spray your blending sponge with this formula before applying foundation to lock the base down from the very first layer.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: PVP (Polyvinylpyrrolidone) creates a breathable, microscopic mesh that acts as a structural net for cosmetic pigments.
